name: How does artificial turf compare to natural grass in terms of maintenance?

mainEntity.name: How does artificial turf compare to natural grass in terms of maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artificial turf requires significantly less maintenance than natural grass, especially in the Las Vegas climate. Natural grass demands frequent watering, regular mowing, fertilizing, pest control, and weeding to stay healthy and green. Artificial turf, conversely, eliminates these tasks entirely. Its maintenance typically involves occasional rinsing to remove dust or pet waste and brushing to maintain fiber uprightness, which is far less time-consuming and resource-intensive. This translates to substantial savings in water, labor, and gardening supplies over the lifespan of the turf.
acceptedAnswer.description: Artificial turf requires far less maintenance than natural grass, eliminating watering, mowing, fertilizing, and pest control, saving time and resources.
